meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage 渠道,支持本地(macOS)或 Photon 远程两种模式。它会从 channels 分支拷入适配器、注册并安装依赖、构建验证、写入环境变量、重启服务,再解析你的手机号或 Apple ID 邮箱作为会话地址。
howto.when: 当你提到「add imessage」「connect imessage」「add photon」等关键词时触发;通常也用于 /setup 流程中需要接入 iMessage 渠道的时候。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage,用本地模式
say.note: 读取本机 chat.db,需给 Node 授予完全磁盘访问

say.text: 用 Photon 远程方式接入 iMessage

say.note: 它会作为你的身份和会话地址使用

howto.what_en: Adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: local (macOS) or remote (Photon API). It copies the adapter, registers it, installs the dependency, builds and tests, writes env keys, restarts the service, and resolves your handle.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon" and similar phrases, or when the setup flow needs an iMessage channel.

say_en.text: Add iMessage to NanoClaw in local mode
say_en.note: Reads this Mac's chat.db; needs Full Disk Access
The only option off macOS; needs server URL and API key
Used as your identity and the conversation address
